findings.source_passage: every reclining mariner started to his feet as if some winged spirit had lighted in the rigging, and hailed the mortal crew
findings.why_it_matters: The precise image of the spirit 'lighted in the rigging' and 'hailed the mortal crew' is atmospherically and rhythmically distinctive; the draft collapses it to 'as if a winged spirit hailed us,' losing the rigging detail and the contrast of 'mortal crew.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the phrasing 'started to his feet as if some winged spirit had lighted in the rigging, and hailed the mortal crew' verbatim or very close to it.

findings.source_passage: While his one live leg made lively echoes along the deck, every stroke of his dead limb sounded like a coffin-tap. On life and death this old man walked.
findings.why_it_matters: This is one of the chapter's most interpretively weighted sentences—the explicit 'coffin-tap' and the epigrammatic 'On life and death this old man walked' carry enormous symbolic freight. The draft preserves 'coffin-taps' and the epigram but softens 'every stroke of his dead limb sounded like' to 'his dead limb struck,' losing the sonic precision and the cadence.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'every stroke of his dead limb sounded like a coffin-tap' verbatim to recover the carefully constructed sound-image.

findings.source_passage: The strange, upheaving, lifting tendency of the taffrail breeze filling the hollows of so many sails, made the buoyant, hovering deck to feel like air beneath the feet; while still she rushed along, as if two antagonistic influences were struggling in her—one to mount direct to heaven, the other to drive yawingly to some horizontal goal.
findings.source_locator: paragraph 3, after 'piled-up craft rolled down before the wind'
findings.why_it_matters: The syntactic elaborateness—'filling the hollows of so many sails,' the precise 'two antagonistic influences,' 'mount direct to heaven,' 'horizontal goal'—is voice-defining and thematically crucial (it foreshadows Ahab's split fate). The draft strips it to bare paraphrase.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full sentence including 'filling the hollows of so many sails,' 'two antagonistic influences,' and 'mount direct to heaven … horizontal goal.'

findings.source_passage: as for days and days we voyaged along, through seas so wearily, lonesomely mild, that all space, in repugnance to our vengeful errand, seemed vacating itself of life before our urn-like prow
findings.why_it_matters: 'Wearily, lonesomely mild' (adverbs modifying an adjective in a distinctly Melvillean construction) and the death-symbolism of 'urn-like prow' are lost; draft has only 'lonesomely mild' and retains 'urn-like prow' but drops 'wearily' and the whole framing clause about 'blue blandness' and 'devilish charm.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'beneath all its blue blandness, some thought there lurked a devilish charm' and 'wearily, lonesomely mild' to preserve the atmospheric irony of the passage.

findings.source_passage: day after day tore on through all the swift madness and gladness of the demoniac waves
findings.why_it_matters: The oxymoronic 'madness and gladness' and 'demoniac waves' are rhythmically memorable and tonally specific; they also evoke the Pequod-as-doomed-vessel motif. The draft omits this clause entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert 'as if manned by painted sailors in wax, day after day tore on through all the swift madness and gladness of the demoniac waves' or a close approximation.

findings.source_passage: the silent ship, as if manned by painted sailors in wax
findings.why_it_matters: 'Painted sailors in wax' is a visually arresting, frequently noticed image. Its omission reduces the uncanny quality of the storm-passage.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the simile 'as if manned by painted sailors in wax' before 'day after day tore on.'

summary: The draft competently compresses events but repeatedly flattens Melville's most distinctive sentence-shapes—the 'coffin-tap' construction, the 'two antagonistic influences' passage, the 'blue blandness / devilish charm' irony, and the 'painted sailors in wax' image—producing three medium-severity voice-flattening failures that collectively trigger regeneration.
